## Design

### 2026-10-10 – Initially I began by researching into how radio transmission works, I learnt about the LC tank and how transistors assist with the amplification process of this and how in order to change the frequenc

**2h**

Initially I began by researching into how radio transmission works, I learnt about the LC tank and how transistors assist with the amplification process of this and how in order to change the frequency used,  you can just vary the capacitance (shown with the formula (2*pi*(LC)^1/2)^-1 =f). Finally, I researched into how the  signal is passed through a RF amplifier before an antenna converting the electrical oscillations into EM waves. I explored a variety of websites such as electronics tutorials and dummies alongside speaking with a physics teacher at my school (not factored into time)

### 2026-10-11 – I did some further resarch into AM radios to see how they worked in comparison to the standard FM radio. I furthermore looked at a few standard AM transmitter circuits before compiling a few into my o

**3h**

I did some further resarch into AM radios to see how they worked in comparison to the standard FM radio. I furthermore looked at a few standard AM transmitter circuits before compiling a few into my own. I designed each part of it separately before conbining into one and then calculating the frequency range I would be able to achieve. I double checked my  circuit diagram with AI which approved it.
